levels.name: First Push
levels.hint: Walk into a crate to push it onto the bay.

levels.name: Around the Corner
levels.hint: Crates only go where you push them. Get on the other side.

levels.name: Two Crates
levels.hint: Every bay needs a crate. Take them one at a time.

levels.name: Mind the Pillar
levels.hint: A crate in a corner never comes out. Z undoes.

levels.name: Short Cut
levels.hint: Come at the bottom crate from the side.

levels.name: Three in a Row
levels.hint: Push the wrong crate first and the others jam.

levels.name: Behind the Stacks
levels.hint: Walk round the stacks to push from above.

levels.name: Parking Space
levels.hint: Park one crate out of the way, then come back for it.

levels.name: Crossroads
levels.hint: Three crates, three bays. Order matters.

levels.name: Night Shift
levels.hint: Clear a lane before you fill it.
